# C1 NOTE — par-p01

Moved from C1 (pristine essence and SUMMARY only):

## SUMMARY

Homage to Śiva-as-the-self-of-all-levels, then the bow to consciousness as the Lord's heart: world-shaped yet world-surpassing, pulsating in supreme-power shape.

## VOICE MAP

Kṣemarāja venerating; maṅgala + authorship + vow.

## KEY TERMS

* **nikhilatattvātman** — self-of-all-levels: scope in one compound.
* **viśvātmikā/taduttīrṇā** — world-shaped/world-surpassing: paradox held whole (print taduttirṇāṃ, normalized ū in T1).
* **parādiśakti** — supreme-etc.-power: Parā/Parāparā/Aparā scale promised.
* **numaḥ** — we venerate/praise (Pradipaka: praise).

## CRUXES

Authorship: edition (Kṣemarāja, maṅgala + colophon internal) vs Hareesh (Nāgānanda) — logged, unadjudicated.
